lines.trans: Good afternoon, Courtyard Inn in Chengdu, Qing speaking—how may I help you?
Who's calling right at noon, Qing? Is another neighbor asking about a courtyard seat?
Yes, operator, read the station telegram a bit slower... arriving on the early express at three?!
Three in the afternoon?! Hold on—isn't the anniversary tea scheduled for six tonight?!
Thank you so much for calling ahead—goodbye! Gentlemen, put your teacups down right now!
Did you just say our guest of honor is arriving three full hours early?!
Track repairs shifted his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express straight into Chengdu!
Only three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is only half rehearsed!
Take a deep breath first, boss, before you shake the glasses right off your nose.
First task: I sprint straight to the kitchen so Mei heats both ovens right away!
Second task: Zhou, send quick word down Wutong Lane inviting neighbors for half past three.

words.gloss: measure word for tops, luggage, matters

lines.trans: Wait—right after I checked in Rooms Two and Six, where did their keys disappear to?!

words.gloss: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)

meanings.note: Pinyin: yī. Changes tone to yí before 4th tone (一个 yí gè) and yì before 1st/2nd/3rd tones (一杯 yì bēi).

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 工作上没什么特别的事情发生，就是十二歌王有一件事情我觉得有点不妥。
examples.trans: Nothing unusual happened at work, except there was one detail on Twelve Singers that felt slightly off to me.

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yí bàn. Combines 一 ('one') + 半 ('half'); note yī shifts to yí before 4th-tone bàn.

examples.text: 这壶热茶我们已经喝了一半。
examples.trans: We have already drunk half of this pot of hot tea.

examples.text: 第二页乐谱有一半还没有写完。
examples.trans: Half of the second page of sheet music is still unfinished.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yì diǎnr. Erhua quantifier/adverb 一 ('one') + 点儿 ('little bit'); used after adjectives (低一点儿 'a tiny bit flat') or before 也不/都没 ('not at all').

examples.text: 那根高音钢丝听起来还稍微低一点儿，再调一下吧。
examples.trans: That treble steel string still sounds a tiny bit flat; let's tune it a touch more.

examples.text: 水性的花园油漆气味很小，走廊里一点儿也不呛人。
examples.trans: Water-based garden paint has very little odour and isn't pungent in the hallway at all.

meanings.note: Pinyin: sān. Cardinal number 3; combines with measure words (三个) and floors (三楼).

examples.text: 不在，只有我的笔和三张旧收据！
examples.trans: Not there—only my pen and three old receipts!

examples.text: 三瓶牛奶、二十个鸡蛋、黄油、奶酪和红苹果！
examples.trans: Three bottles of milk, twenty eggs, butter, cheese, and red apples!

examples.text: 上周的报告看了吗？十二歌王收视率第一，超过第二名三个点，这是历史纪录。
examples.trans: Did you read last week's report? Twelve Singers ranked number one in ratings, beating second place by three full points — a historic record.

examples.text: 淳总，十二歌王今天走台，但是惠美怎么都联系不上，已经迟到三个小时了！
examples.trans: Mr Chun, Twelve Singers has stage blocking today, except nobody can reach Huimei — she's already three hours late!

meanings.note: Pinyin: shàng. Used both as a directional verb/complement ('up, onto') and location word ('on top of').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià. Used for downward motion ('go down'), location ('under'), or 'next' (下周).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xià wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个下午 ('an afternoon').

examples.text: 您尽管看，宋老师。星期一下午大堂暗。
examples.trans: Go right ahead, Teacher Song. Monday afternoon the lobby was dim.

examples.text: 先别对外面透露一个字！让两兄弟先过完这个星期五下午！
examples.trans: Not a single word to anyone outside yet! Let the two brothers have their Friday afternoon first!

meanings.note: Friendly farewell xiàcì jiàn.

examples.text: 今天聊得很开心，下次见！
examples.trans: Great chatting today, see you next time!

examples.text: 我们下次见！
examples.trans: See you next time!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bú shì. In 不是……吗？, forms a rhetorical question ('didn't you...? / isn't it...?'); bù shifts to bú before 4th-tone shì.

examples.text: 你不是说今天下午要去集市吗？
examples.trans: Didn't you say you were going to the market this afternoon?

examples.text: 那把钥匙不是一直放在抽屉里吗？
examples.trans: Hasn't that key been in the drawer all along?

examples.text: 你这么好的姑娘，我为什么不见呀？
examples.trans: Why wouldn't I meet such a talented young woman?

examples.text: 这件事我们再商量一下。
examples.trans: Let's discuss this matter a bit more.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liǎng. Used instead of 二 when counting things with a measure word (两个, 两把, 两间).

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gè. Most common Mandarin measure word (量词), placed between a number/demonstrative and a noun (一个人, 这个).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 刚烤好的面包卷！趁热拿一个吧。
examples.trans: Freshly baked bread rolls! Take one while it is hot.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōng wǔ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个中午 ('a noon hour').

examples.text: 先生？他说：请别打开白纸包，我星期五中午来。
examples.trans: Sir? He says: Please do not open the white paper parcel; I will come Friday at noon.

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yě. Always stands directly before the verb or adjective, never at the end of a clause.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: le. After a verb, marks completion; at the end of a sentence, signals a change of situation.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Measure word (量词): 件 (jiàn), e.g. 一件事 ('a matter').

examples.text: 您好好休息，有事随时按铃。
examples.trans: Rest well, ma'am; ring the bell anytime if you need anything.

examples.text: 为了一个木头小火车紧张？这事越来越怪了。
examples.trans: Nervous over a wooden toy train? This story gets stranger by the hour.

meanings.note: Pinyin: èr. Used in counting, ordinals (第二), room numbers, and multi-digit numbers (二十); use 两 before measure words.

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 二十五年前我在附近教钢琴，不过记忆淡了。
examples.trans: Twenty-five years ago I taught piano nearby, though memories fade.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shén me. Asks 'what?' on its own (什么？) or modifies a noun (什么茶 'what kind of tea').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: jīn wǎn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 今天晚上 ('this evening').

examples.text: 今晚我应该能睡个好觉了。
examples.trans: Tonight I should be able to sleep well after all.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tā. Third-person singular masculine pronoun; pronounced identically to 她 and 它.

examples.text: 他没要回那个装木头小火车的箱子吗？
examples.trans: Did he not ask back for that case with the wooden train?

examples.text: 他留了纸条，请我们保管到星期五。
examples.trans: He left a note asking us to keep it until Friday.

件.gloss: measure word for tops, luggage, matters

meanings.en: measure word for tops, luggage, matters
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiàn. Counts upper-body garments (一件外套), suitcases (一件行李), and affairs (一件事).

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 您看，这件软羊毛开衫是全新的，试试吧。
examples.trans: Look, this soft wool cardigan is brand-new; try it on.

meanings.note: Pinyin: huì. Expresses either an acquired skill (会弹钢琴) or likelihood in the future (会下雨).

examples.text: 停电的时候，纸还能用。
examples.trans: Paper still works when the power goes out.

examples.text: 就算四号房空着，旧电线也会响两下。
examples.trans: Even when room four is empty, the old wire still rings twice.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèi. Polite counterpart of 个 when counting guests, customers, or teachers (一位客人, 这位老师).

examples.text: 太谢谢你们两位了。
examples.trans: Thank you both so very much.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nǐ. Everyday singular 'you' among colleagues, friends, and peers; use 您 for polite respect.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xìn. Measure word (量词): 封 (fēng), e.g. 一封信 ('a letter').

examples.text: 我在看天气，小美！铃铛旁边这封厚信是谁放的？
examples.trans: I am checking the weather, Mei! Who put this thick letter beside the bell?

examples.text: 周经理！您脸色全白了！快坐下——信上写了什么？
examples.trans: Manager Zhou! Your face went completely white! Sit down quickly—what does the letter say?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a part used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个儿。
examples.trans: I have a 儿.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的儿。
examples.trans: This is a very good 儿.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān. Placed before the verb to sequence actions: 先…再… ('first…, then…').

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiān sheng. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位先生 ('a gentleman').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 先生，箱子安全锁在柜子里。请问您贵姓？
examples.trans: Sir, the bag is locked safely in our closet. May I ask your surname?

入住.gloss: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)

meanings.en: check in, move into (a hotel or residence)
meanings.note: Taking up lodging for an event or trip.

examples.text: 所有参赛歌手都已经入住酒店了。
examples.trans: All competing singers have checked into the hotel.

examples.text: 凭身份证就可以在前台办理入住。
examples.trans: You can check in at the front desk with your ID.

meanings.note: Pinyin: liù. Cardinal number 6.

examples.text: 老陈……小晴……快告诉我今晚六号房空着。
examples.trans: Chen... Qing... please tell me room six is free tonight.

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài jiàn. Standard Mandarin farewell at any time of day.

examples.text: 路上小心，我们明天再见！
examples.trans: Take care on the road—see you again tomorrow!

examples.text: 谢谢您的帮忙，再见！
examples.trans: Thank you for your help—goodbye!

冲刺.gloss: to sprint; dash at full speed

meanings.en: to make a final sprint; to dash rapidly toward a goal
meanings.note: Pinyin: chōng cì. Originally from track racing (百米冲刺, hundred-meter dash), also used humorously for hurrying on errands.

examples.text: 头一件事：我百米冲刺去厨房，让小美立刻把两台烤箱都烧热！
examples.trans: First task: I sprint straight to the kitchen so Mei heats both ovens right away!

examples.text: 距离三点只剩二十分钟，大家都进入最后冲刺阶段。
examples.trans: With only twenty minutes left until three, everyone entered the final sprint.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gāng cái. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 刚才那一刻 ('that moment just now').

examples.text: 谢谢你，小美。刚才吓了一跳，手都凉了！
examples.trans: Thank you, Mei. That gave me such a start just now that my hands went cold!

examples.text: 您刚才忘在楼下前台汤碗旁边了。
examples.trans: You left it downstairs beside the soup bowl at the front desk.

related.gloss: that moment just now (measure word 个)

meanings.note: Pinyin: bié. Most commonly means 'do not' in polite commands (别担心 'don't worry'); as a verb, 'pin/clip on'.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dào. Works as main verb ('arrive') or result complement ('succeed in reaching/perceiving', 找到, 听到).

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shèng. Describes time, items, or money remaining (只剩五分钟 'only five minutes left').

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

examples.text: 那我也不能不管吧，这怎么办啊？
examples.trans: Well, I cannot just ignore it either — what should I do?

examples.text: 把这件事交给他去办，你完全可以放心。
examples.trans: Leave this matter to him to handle — you can rest completely assured.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bàn. Follows a measure word for 'and a half' (七点半 '7:30') or precedes a measure word for 'half a' (半个小时).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 七点半有八位饿肚子的客人下楼啊！
examples.trans: At seven thirty, eight hungry guests are coming downstairs!

meanings.note: Pinyin: chú fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间厨房 ('a kitchen').

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 糟了！周经理，小晴，厨房出急事了！
examples.trans: Oh no! Manager Zhou, Qing, we have a kitchen emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qù. Movement away from the speaker, as main verb (去车站) or directional complement (上去).

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yòu. Marks an action repeating, or pairs two qualities in 又A又B ('both A and B').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

口气.gloss: tone of voice; pent-up frustration (in 咽下这口气)

meanings.en: tone of voice; pent-up frustration (in 咽下这口气)
meanings.note: Used both for manner of speaking and stomaching an insult.

examples.text: 受了这么大的委屈，谁都没法轻易咽下这口气。
examples.trans: Wronged that badly, nobody could swallow the insult easily.

examples.text: 和合作伙伴沟通时请注意说话的口气。
examples.trans: Mind your tone of voice when speaking with partners.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ. Read zhǐ as the adverb 'only' before verbs, and zhī as a measure word for cups, boxes, and small animals.

examples.text: 而且他今晚八点到这里——只剩四十分钟了！
examples.trans: And he arrives here at eight o'clock this evening—in forty minutes!

examples.text: 只剩三十五分钟了！他肯定会写一星差评！
examples.trans: Only thirty-five minutes left! He will surely write a one-star bad review!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhǐ shì. Softens an explanation ('I simply…').

examples.text: 不怪你们。只是我身上只有这件外套！
examples.trans: It is not your fault. Still, I only have this one coat on me!

examples.text: 我只是检查安全。这是我的工作。
examples.trans: I am simply checking security. That is my job.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ké yǐ. Polite modal verb for asking or granting permission (可以吗？ 'Is that alright?').

examples.text: 真的可以吗？看着又好看又暖和！
examples.trans: Is that really alright? It looks both lovely and warm!

examples.text: 阁楼书房？我可以先上去看看吗？
examples.trans: An attic study? May I go up and see it first?

meanings.note: Classifier/noun tái ('stage; classifier for equipment/TVs').

examples.text: 演播室的设备一人盯一台。
examples.trans: Watch one piece of studio equipment per person.

examples.text: 桌上有两台笔记本电脑。
examples.trans: There are two laptops on the desk.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hào. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个号码 ('a number').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ma. Placed at the end of any statement to turn it into a neutral yes/no question.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a verb used in conversational Mandarin.

examples.text: 我有一个吸。
examples.trans: I have a 吸.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的吸。
examples.trans: This is a very good 吸.

meanings.note: Pinyin: ya. Gentle exclamation of surprise or realization.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 呀，这就是星期一火车上那只双胞胎箱子吗？
examples.trans: Oh, is this that twin suitcase from Monday's train?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhōunián. Measure word: 个.

examples.text: 今天是他们结婚十周年纪念日。
examples.trans: Today is their tenth wedding anniversary.

examples.text: 公司举行了成立周年的庆祝活动。
examples.trans: The company held a celebration for its anniversary.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hé. Joins nouns or pronouns ('A and B'), NEVER two whole clauses; also means 'with' (和你一样).

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.en: we; us; our (inclusive of both the speaker and the listener)
meanings.note: Pinyin: zánmen. Unlike 我们 (which can exclude the listener), 咱们 specifically includes the person spoken to, creating a warm, collegial, or colloquial tone. Directly modifies nouns without 的 in set expressions like 咱们这行.

examples.text: 干咱们这行，谁不想跟他学习？
examples.trans: In our line of work, who wouldn't want to learn from him?

examples.text: 淳于总已经批准咱们的方案了。
examples.trans: Director Chun Yu has already approved our proposal.

meanings.en: four-hand piano duet played together on one keyboard
meanings.note: Pinyin: sì shǒu lián tán. Literally 'four hands linked playing,' naming two pianists sharing one piano bench.

examples.text: 下午四点我和宋老师把四手联弹钢琴曲最后排练一遍！
examples.trans: And at four this afternoon Song and I run through our four-hand piano duet one last time!

examples.text: 只剩三个小时了！蛋糕还只是面糊，四手联弹也只排了一半！
examples.trans: Only three hours left! The cakes are still batter, and the duet is only half rehearsed!

meanings.note: Pinyin: zài. As main verb/preposition, gives location (在院子里); before another verb, marks ongoing action ('be doing').

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò. Means both 'sit down' (请坐) and 'ride inside a vehicle' (坐火车 'take the train').

examples.text: 是的，宋老师，二楼四号房！坐火车累吗？
examples.trans: Yes, Teacher Song, room four on the second floor! Was the train ride tiring?

examples.text: 您先坐下，别着急，我们马上看行李牌。
examples.trans: Please sit down first and do not worry; we will check the luggage tag right away.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà. Everyday adjective for size, age, and strong wind or rain.

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 两双棕色大男鞋，还有灰色毛衣。
examples.trans: Two pairs of big brown men's shoes, plus grey sweaters.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dà jiā. Warm collective pronoun including everyone in the group.

examples.text: 大家早上好！欢迎你，小晴。都准备好了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning, everyone! Welcome, Qing. Is everything ready?

examples.text: 有进步！今天小院迎接兄弟重逢——大家保持安静端庄！
examples.trans: Progress! Today our courtyard hosts a brotherly reunion—quiet dignity from everyone!

meanings.note: Pinyin: tài. Often frames 太 + adj + 了 for warm exclamations (太好了！ 'Wonderful!').

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

meanings.note: Prefix/noun tóu ('first, initial; head').

examples.text: 开篇的头一句就是道可道。
examples.trans: The very first line at the opening is Dao Ke Dao.

examples.text: 这是我头一回进大型演播室。
examples.trans: This is my very first time inside a major TV studio.

它们.gloss: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)

meanings.en: they; them (for things, plants, or animals)
meanings.note: Pinyin: tā men. Non-human plural pronoun 它 ('it') + plural suffix 们.

examples.text: 这几扇旧窗板都是灰色的，我以前都没注意过它们。
examples.trans: These old shutters are all grey; I never even noticed them before.

examples.text: 把工具擦干净以后，请把它们放回木箱里。
examples.trans: After wiping the tools clean, please put them back in the wooden chest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wán. Most often follows an action verb as a result complement meaning 'finish doing' (读完, 弹完).

examples.text: 每次弹完琴，他都问为什么下雨天钢琴声音更暖。
examples.trans: Whenever I finished playing, he asked why the piano sounded warmer on rainy days.

examples.text: 十二下敲完了……大门外面街上空荡荡的。
examples.trans: Twelve chimes have finished... and the street outside the gate is completely empty.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dìng. Used for setting a time or booking an appointment (定好 'settle/fix').

examples.text: 定好闹钟吧，老陈。明早我们跑赢冷水！
examples.trans: Set your alarm, Chen. Tomorrow morning we outrun the cold water!

examples.text: 我们已经定好了明天见面的时间。
examples.trans: We have already set the time to meet tomorrow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: duì. Means 'correct!' on its own, 'right' as a result complement (拿对), or 'to/toward' before a noun.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 看拉链旁边……对，有她的名字缩写！
examples.trans: Check beside the zipper... yes, her name initials are here!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo shí. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个小时 ('an hour').

examples.text: 没有啊，周经理，南方来的夫妻一小时前住进六号房了。
examples.trans: No, Manager Zhou, the couple from the south checked into room six an hour ago.

examples.text: 七点整——比早餐早半个小时。
examples.trans: Seven sharp—half an hour earlier than breakfast.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo qíng. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's new receptionist.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiáo měi. Friendly name of Courtyard Inn's baker and barista.

examples.text: 你好！你就是小晴吧？我是厨房的小美。
examples.trans: Hello! You must be Qing, right? I am Mei from the kitchen.

examples.text: 你好，小美，很高兴认识你！好香啊！
examples.trans: Hello, Mei, nice to meet you! Something smells wonderful!

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiǎo yuàn kè zhàn. Eight-room boutique courtyard inn on Wutong Lane in Chengdu.

examples.text: 欢迎来到小院客栈，小晴。明天不会无聊了。
examples.trans: Welcome to Courtyard Inn, Qing. Tomorrow will not be boring.

examples.text: 小院客栈，早上好！我是小晴。
examples.trans: Courtyard Inn, good morning! This is Qing speaking.

meanings.note: Pinyin: jiù. Highlights immediacy, exact location (就在这里), or smooth consequence ('then').

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bāng. Everyday verb for helping someone (帮我一下 'give me a hand').

examples.text: 我来帮您。哎呀，里面装了石头吗？
examples.trans: Let me help you. Goodness, did you pack stones inside?

examples.text: 从这儿往里走。我帮您把蓝色行李箱提上去。
examples.trans: Walk inward from here. I will carry the blue suitcase up for you.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zuò wèi. Combines 座 ('seat/place') + 位 ('spot/position'); measure word: 个 (gè).

examples.text: 九号房里的十二个室内座位既明亮又宽敞。
examples.trans: The twelve indoor seats inside Room Nine are both bright and spacious.

examples.text: 请给面包师和音乐老师在钢琴旁边留两个好座位。
examples.trans: Please save two good seats beside the piano for the baker and the music teacher.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kuài. As an adjective/adverb, 'fast/quickly'; in 快…了, 'about to'.

examples.text: 第一天上班，我走得快。电脑在哪里？
examples.trans: On my first day at work, I walk fast. Where is the computer?

examples.text: 小晴，快看里面！这不是我的箱子！
examples.trans: Qing, look inside quickly! This is not my case!

meanings.note: Pinyin: niàn. Used for reading a letter or notice out loud (念第一行 'read the first line aloud').

examples.text: 二十毫米、铜的、热水器阀门——我一路念过去！
examples.trans: Twenty millimetres, brass, water-heater valve—I will repeat it all the way!

examples.text: 十九条理由？！您是迎接哥哥，还是念火车时刻表呀？
examples.trans: Nineteen reasons?! Are you welcoming your brother or reading a train timetable?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zěn me. Before a verb, asks 'how to do X?' (怎么走) or 'how come…?' (怎么还没来).

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

examples.text: 宋老师，怎么了？您按了门铃！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, what happened? You rang the bell!

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín. Respectful singular 'you' used with elders, teachers, and guests (您好！).

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

examples.text: 就在您额头上，安全得很。
examples.trans: Right there on your forehead, completely safe.

meanings.note: Pinyin: nín hǎo. Respectful greeting using polite 您 ('you') for elders, teachers, and guests.

examples.text: 您好，欢迎来到小院客栈！
examples.trans: Hello, welcome to Courtyard Inn!

examples.text: 老师您好，请进屋喝杯热茶。
examples.trans: Hello, Teacher—please come inside for a cup of hot tea.

meanings.note: Pinyin: màn. Everyday adjective for slow speed; doubled in 慢慢 ('slowly, take your time').

examples.text: 得救了！失陪一分钟，宋老师，您慢喝热茶！
examples.trans: Saved! Excuse me one minute, Teacher Song—enjoy your hot tea!

examples.text: 再等几分钟，志豪先生。中午城里堵车总是很慢。
examples.trans: Give it a few more minutes, Mr Zhihao. Midday city traffic is always slow.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chéng dū. Historic southwestern Chinese city famed for courtyards and tea houses.

examples.text: 来成都的第一个晚上，怎么能难过呢！
examples.trans: On your very first evening in Chengdu, how could you sit around sad!

examples.text: 真的吗？您在成都认识什么人吗？
examples.trans: Really? Do you know someone here in Chengdu?

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǒ. First-person singular pronoun; add 的 for 'my' (我的) and 们 for 'we/us' (我们).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fáng. Measure word (量词): 间 (jiān), e.g. 一间房 ('a room').

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

examples.text: 那里没人。那是四号房的门铃。
examples.trans: Nobody is there. That is the buzzer from room four.

meanings.en: hit; make (a call); give (a score); fetch
meanings.note: Pinyin: dǎ. Light verb forming dozens of everyday expressions (打电话 'make a phone call').

examples.text: 小晴，马上给火车站失物处打电话。
examples.trans: Qing, call the train station lost-and-found office right away.

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.en: measure word for handled objects; disposal marker
meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎ. Counts items with handles or backs (一把钥匙, 一把椅子); as a preposition, fronts a definite object before an action verb.

examples.text: 早上好。没锁，先把把手往上提，再推。
examples.trans: Good morning. Not locked; lift the handle up first, then push.

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

捎.gloss: to pass along; bring word or a parcel

meanings.en: to send word or carry something along for someone on the way
meanings.note: Pinyin: shāo. Warm neighborly verb frequently heard in 捎个信儿 ('send quick word') or 捎东西 ('bring something along').

examples.text: 第二件事：周经理，赶紧给梧桐巷街坊捎个信儿，请大家三点半到。
examples.trans: Second task: Zhou, send quick word down Wutong Lane inviting neighbors for half past three.

examples.text: 面包师路过客栈门口时，顺便给老陈捎了一袋新鲜杏仁。
examples.trans: Passing the inn gate, the baker kindly dropped off a bag of fresh almonds for Chen.

meanings.note: Pinyin: diào. As a verb, 'drop'; after another verb, marks removal or disposal (关掉 'turn off', 擦掉 'wipe away').

examples.text: 别担心！用冰气泡水一擦，橙汁就掉。
examples.trans: Do not worry! Wipe it once with cold sparkling water and orange juice comes right out.

examples.text: 冬天用掉最后一个了。只有桥那边的老五金店有这个尺寸。
examples.trans: Used the last one in winter. Only the old hardware shop past the bridge carries this size.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pái. Counts rows of keys, seats, or houses (一排钥匙 'a row of keys').

examples.text: 等星期五中午箱子主人进来，我一定坐第一排看！
examples.trans: When the suitcase owner walks in Friday at noon, I am sitting in the front row!

examples.text: 墙上整整齐齐挂着一排钥匙。
examples.trans: A neat row of keys hangs on the wall.

meanings.note: shift a scheduled event earlier than planned

examples.text: 王尔老师，淳于总提前了录影时间！
examples.trans: Teacher Wang Er, Director Chun Yu moved up the taping time!

examples.text: 如有变动请提前通知大家。
examples.trans: If there are changes, please notify everyone in advance.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gǎi. Used for changing plans or converting a building.

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 我们把见面时间改到下午吧。
examples.trans: Let's change our meeting time to the afternoon.

meanings.note: Pinyin: fàng. Everyday verb for placing an object somewhere (放在桌子上).

examples.text: 我们不知道。有人放在台阶上，按了门铃。
examples.trans: We do not know. Someone set it on the step and rang the bell.

examples.text: 小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
examples.trans: Where do the small spoons and napkins go?

related.gloss: handle with care (lift gently, set down gently)

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhéng zhěng. Placed before numbers to stress entirety (整整六年 'six whole years').

examples.text: 何止认识！整整六年，每个星期五我都爬那座木楼梯教钢琴！
examples.trans: More than know it! Every Friday for six whole years I climbed those wooden stairs to teach piano!

examples.text: 这架老钢琴他已经弹了整整三十年。
examples.trans: He has played this old piano for a full thirty years.

meanings.note: Pinyin: zǎo. Alone as a greeting, 早！ means a brisk, friendly 'Morning!'.

examples.text: 我叫老陈。你早到了十分钟。
examples.trans: I'm called Chen. You arrived ten minutes early.

examples.text: 周经理早！桌子很干净，钥匙也准备好了。
examples.trans: Morning, Manager Zhou! The desk is clean, and the keys are ready too.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shì. Links two nouns (我是小晴); do NOT use simple 是 before plain adjectives like 好 or 忙.

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

meanings.note: Pinyin: huǎng. As huǎng (3rd tone), means 'flash past / dazzle the eyes' (晃眼); as huàng (4th tone), means 'sway/shake'.

examples.text: 小晴，那准是磨砂玻璃灯罩晃了眼。
examples.trans: Must be the frosted glass lampshade playing a trick on your eyes, Qing.

examples.text: 正午的阳光照在水面上，亮得有点晃眼。
examples.trans: The midday sunlight shining on the water is bright enough to dazzle the eyes.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wǎn. Describes arriving late or evening time.

examples.text: 打扰一下，志豪先生？不好意思这么晚敲门。
examples.trans: Excuse me, Mr Zhihao? Sorry to knock so late.

examples.text: 这是我这个月睡得最香的一晚，洗澡水也热极了！
examples.trans: Best sleep I have had all month, and the shower water was wonderfully hot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǒu. Expresses both possession ('I have') and existence ('there is'); ALWAYS negated with 没 (没有), never 不.

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 那是什么铃声？有人按了两下！
examples.trans: What was that bell sound? Somebody rang twice!

meanings.note: Pinyin: lái. Movement toward the speaker, as main verb or directional complement (进来 'come in').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 大门口正好来了一辆出租车。
examples.trans: A taxi has just pulled up right at the front gate.

meanings.en: to place an incoming call or telegram notice (also noun 'incoming call')
meanings.note: Pinyin: lái diàn. Polite spoken and front-desk term, e.g. 谢谢提前来电 ('thank you for calling ahead').

examples.text: 太谢谢您提前来电了——再见！两位先生，快把茶杯放下！
examples.trans: Thank you so much for calling ahead—goodbye! Gentlemen, put your teacups down right now!

examples.text: 正午时分车站话务员突然来电，让整个客栈立刻忙碌起来。
examples.trans: An unexpected noon call from the station operator sent the whole inn scrambling into action.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wú tóng xiàng. Tree-lined lane in Chengdu where Courtyard Inn stands.

examples.text: 等一下……梧桐巷十二号，角落里还写着两个童年名字的首字母！
examples.trans: Wait a moment... Number twelve, Wutong Lane, with two childhood initials written in the corner!

examples.text: 宋老师，您一脸惊讶！您认识梧桐巷十二号吗？
examples.trans: Teacher Song, you look amazed! Do you know Number twelve, Wutong Lane?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shēn. Describes deep breaths (深呼吸) or dark shades of color (深蓝色 'dark blue').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 又是深蓝色行李箱！这是宋老师的吗？
examples.trans: Another dark-blue suitcase! Is this Teacher Song's?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diǎn. Marks hours on the clock (八点 'eight o'clock') or 'a bit' (一点).

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

examples.text: 晚上九点？等等，我们一起去开大门。
examples.trans: At nine o'clock? Wait, let us open the gate together.

meanings.note: Pinyin: kǎo xiāng. Measure word (量词): 台, e.g. 一台烤箱 ('an oven').

examples.text: 还好烤箱里的面团已经放进去了。
examples.trans: My dough is already in the oven, at least.

examples.text: 宋老师早！我的肉桂卷刚出烤箱。
examples.trans: Morning, Teacher Song! My cinnamon rolls just came out of the oven.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shāo. Used for fire, heating water (烧水), and electrical burnouts (烧断 'burn through').

examples.text: 是旧电线，把一楼的保险丝烧断了。
examples.trans: It was the old wire—it blew the ground-floor fuse.

examples.text: 我去烧一壶开水。
examples.trans: I'll go and boil a kettle of water.

meanings.note: Pinyin: rè. Describes hot tea, hot water, or warm weather.

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

meanings.note: Pinyin: bān. Counts scheduled trains/flights (同一班火车 'the same train') and work shifts (上班).

examples.text: 真奇怪！我们坐同一班早火车到同一个区。
examples.trans: How strange! We rode the very same morning train to the same district.

examples.text: 等等——星期一你们坐同一班火车，并拿走了她的箱子？
examples.trans: Wait—so you rode the same train on Monday and took her suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: diàn bào. Measure word: 封 (fēng) or 份 (fèn), e.g. 一封加急电报 ('an urgent telegram').

examples.text: 对，话务员，您把车站电报念慢一点儿……坐早一班快车下午三点就到？！
examples.trans: Yes, operator, read the station telegram a bit slower... arriving on the early express at three?!

examples.text: 周经理拿着记好电报内容的便条，急急忙忙往院子里跑。
examples.trans: Holding the slip of paper with the telegram message jotted down, Zhou hurried out into the courtyard.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bǎi. Requires a digit before it in Mandarin (一百 'one hundred', never bare 百 for 100).

examples.text: 留下来跟大家在一起？愿意——一百个愿意！
examples.trans: Stay here together with all of you? Yes—a hundred times yes!

examples.text: 这棵老树已经有一百多年了。
examples.trans: This old tree is already more than a hundred years old.

meanings.note: Pinyin: de. Links modifiers or owners to nouns (我的书 'my book', 安静的院子 'quiet courtyard').

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 纸本子？真的吗？
examples.trans: A paper notebook? Really?

meanings.note: Pinyin: zhí. Describes straight lines or walking straight ahead (直走).

examples.text: 出门左拐，直走到桥。要过河吗？
examples.trans: Left out the gate, straight to the bridge. Do I cross the river?

examples.text: 电线本来就该拉直了。正常保养，别多想。
examples.trans: The wire needed straightening anyway. Routine maintenance—don't read into it.

meanings.note: Pinyin: yǎn jìng. Measure word (量词): 副 (fù), e.g. 一副眼镜 ('a pair of glasses').

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

examples.text: 我的眼镜怎么会在……哎呀！在我头上！
examples.trans: Why would my glasses be in... oh dear! They are on my head!

related.gloss: a pair of glasses (measure word 副)

meanings.note: Pinyin: lì kè. Crisp adverb for immediate action.

examples.text: 你们两位都懂？！放下茶杯——现在立刻跟我进来！
examples.trans: Both of you?! Put down your teacups—come inside with me this instant!

examples.text: 接到电话后，他立刻赶回客栈帮忙。
examples.trans: Right after getting the call, he hurried back to the inn to help.

examples.text: 这是第二啊。
examples.trans: This is second.

examples.text: 那个第二好。
examples.trans: That second is good.

meanings.note: Pinyin: děng deng. Urgent or casual reduplication of 等 ('wait!').

examples.text: 等等，深蓝色的，跟您的一样啊！
examples.trans: Wait—it is dark blue, the same as yours!

examples.text: 等等，这条街就在附近，走过去只要五分钟！
examples.trans: Wait—that street is right nearby, only five minutes on foot!

meanings.note: Pinyin: mǐ. As a measure word after numbers, means 'meter' (十米 'ten meters'); as a noun, 'uncooked rice'.

examples.text: 等等——现在十米外的院子里坐着谁？
examples.trans: Wait—who is sitting ten metres away in our courtyard right now?

examples.text: 五金店就在前面五十米的地方。
examples.trans: The hardware store is fifty meters ahead.

meanings.note: Pinyin: gěi. As main verb, 'give'; as preposition/complement, marks the recipient (给你 'for/to you', 递给我 'pass to me').

examples.text: 跟我当然啦！客气话留给客人吧。
examples.trans: With me, of course! Save the polite talk for the guests.

examples.text: 给您四号钥匙。早餐从七点半到十点。
examples.trans: Here is key number four for you. Breakfast is from seven thirty to ten.

meanings.en: to maintain, service, or repair equipment, tracks, or buildings
meanings.note: Pinyin: wéi xiū. Works both as a verb ('repair') and as an event noun ('upkeep').

examples.text: 铁轨维修把他的晚班车改到了下午直达成都的快车上！
examples.trans: Track repairs shifted his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express straight into Chengdu!

examples.text: 老陈每隔几个月就把客栈木门和铁锁仔细维修保养一遍。
examples.trans: Every few months Chen carefully repairs and oils the inn's wooden doors and iron latches.

meanings.note: Pinyin: láo bǎn. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位老板 ('a boss / shop owner').

examples.text: 老板，看一下桌子后面的镜子。
examples.trans: Boss, take a look in the mirror behind the desk.

examples.text: 老板正在开锁呢！别挂电话，等我一秒钟。
examples.trans: The owner is unlocking it right now! Stay on the phone, wait one second.

related.gloss: a boss / shop owner (measure word 位)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá. Measure word (量词): 杯 (bēi), e.g. 一杯茶 ('a cup of tea').

examples.text: 第一条规矩：先喝热茶，再去开门。
examples.trans: Rule number one: drink hot tea first, then go answer the door.

examples.text: 先喝杯热茶，吃个肉桂卷坐十分钟吧！
examples.trans: Have a cup of hot tea and a cinnamon roll for ten minutes first!

related.gloss: a cup of tea (measure word 杯)

meanings.note: Pinyin: chá bēi. Measure word (量词): 只 (zhǐ), e.g. 一只茶杯 ('a teacup').

examples.text: 只有裙子、乐谱，还有我最喜欢的茶杯！
examples.trans: Only dresses, sheet music, and my favourite teacup!

examples.text: 里面的茶杯呢？还完好吗？
examples.trans: And the teacup inside? Is it still intact?

meanings.note: Pinyin: dàn gāo. Measure word (量词): 块 (kuài), e.g. 一块蛋糕 ('a piece of cake').

examples.text: 他爷爷会切热柠檬蛋糕，上面撒一层白糖粉！
examples.trans: His grandfather sliced warm lemon cake with a dusting of powdered sugar on top!

examples.text: 十一点二十分。小美，蛋糕好了吗？
examples.trans: Eleven twenty. Mei, is the cake ready?

related.gloss: a piece of cake (measure word 块)

meanings.en: neighbors; folks on the same street
meanings.note: Pinyin: jiē fang. Measure word (量词): 位 (wèi), e.g. 一位街坊 ('a neighborhood resident').

examples.text: 超过八十年的小院建筑，只要一楼每天服务街坊邻居，禁止改成私人办公室。
examples.trans: Any courtyard building over eighty years old may not become private offices as long as the ground floor serves neighbours daily.

examples.text: 每天服务街坊邻居——就像对公众开放的早间咖啡馆？！
examples.trans: Serves neighbours daily—like a morning café open to the public?!

meanings.en: want; need; will / be going to
meanings.note: Pinyin: yào. Direct verb for ordering/requesting ('want'), obligation ('need to'), or imminent future (要下雨了).

examples.text: 今天四号房的客人住一整个星期，一定要完美！
examples.trans: Today's guest in room four is staying a whole week; everything must be perfect!

examples.text: 我要看预订本子，可是找不到我的眼镜了！
examples.trans: I need to read the booking ledger, yet I cannot find my glasses!

meanings.note: Pinyin: ràng. Everyday causative/polite-offer verb (让我看看 'let me have a look').

examples.text: 因为好咖啡和热面包让人开心呀！
examples.trans: Because good coffee and warm bread make people happy!

examples.text: 宋老师，让我来给您倒新鲜橙汁！
examples.trans: Teacher Song, allow me to pour fresh orange juice for you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: huà wù yuán. Measure word: 位 (wèi) politely or 名 (míng).

examples.text: 对，话务员，您把车站电报念慢一点儿……坐早一班快车下午三点就到？！
examples.trans: Yes, operator, read the station telegram a bit slower... arriving on the early express at three?!

examples.text: 还好话务员接通得及时，小院客栈才能提前三个小时做准备。
examples.trans: Thankfully the operator patched the message through in time, giving Courtyard Inn three hours to prepare.

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuō. Most common verb of speaking.

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 我还没喝早咖啡呢，千万别说急事！
examples.trans: I have not had my morning coffee yet; please do not say emergency!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng. At the start of a request, means 'please' (请进, 请坐, 请问); before a person, 'invite / treat'.

examples.text: 太好了。请告诉我需要知道什么。
examples.trans: Great. Please tell me what I need to know.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

meanings.note: Pinyin: qǐng wèn. Polite question opener used everywhere in Mandarin.

examples.text: 早上好！请问，门锁了吗？
examples.trans: Good morning! Excuse me, is the door locked?

examples.text: 我正在打……您好，请问有人找蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: I am calling now... Hello, excuse me, is anyone looking for a blue suitcase?

meanings.note: Pinyin: shuí. Question pronoun for people; stays in the exact spot of the answer (这是谁的？ 'Whose is this?').

examples.text: 谁也别说出去！门铃响的时候要微笑。
examples.trans: Do not tell anyone! Smile warmly when the bell rings.

examples.text: 一点没破！是谁送回来的？
examples.trans: Not cracked at all! Who brought it back?

meanings.note: Pinyin: xiè xie. Standard expression of gratitude; takes an optional person after it (谢谢您).

examples.text: 啊，开了！谢谢。我是小晴，新来的前台。
examples.trans: Oh, it opened! Thank you. I am Qing, the new receptionist.

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

meanings.note: Used formally for VIP guests or playfully for an important admirer.

examples.text: 今天演播厅要接待几位重要的贵宾。
examples.trans: Today the studio is hosting several important VIPs.

examples.text: 送这么好的礼物，是不是你忘了哪位贵宾？
examples.trans: Sending such a nice gift—did you forget some special VIP?

meanings.note: Urgent conversational adverb gǎnjǐn.

examples.text: 赶紧告诉我。
examples.trans: Hurry up and tell me.

examples.text: 赶紧去休息吧。
examples.trans: Hurry and get some rest.

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē. Measure word (量词): 辆 (liàng), e.g. 一辆车 ('a vehicle').

examples.text: 送牛奶的车在城外坏了。你们看冰箱！
examples.trans: The milk delivery van broke down outside town. Look at the fridge!

examples.text: 门口停着一辆蓝色的出租车。
examples.trans: A blue taxi is parked outside the gate.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Pinyin: chē zhàn. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个车站 ('a station').

examples.text: 啊……下这么大的雨，车站附近酒店全满了。
examples.trans: Ah... in rain this heavy, every hotel near the station was full.

examples.text: 雨天打车难，我们早点去车站吧。
examples.trans: Hailing a cab in the rain takes longer, so let's head to the station early.

related.gloss: be stuck in a traffic jam

meanings.note: Formal verb dáchéng ('reach a deal or consensus').

examples.text: 她昨天跟原野已经达成了庭外和解。
examples.trans: Yesterday she reached an out-of-court settlement with Yuanye.

examples.text: 两家公司很快达成了合作。
examples.trans: The two firms quickly reached a partnership.

meanings.note: Pinyin: hái. Everyday adverb meaning 'still' (还在), 'not yet' (还没), or 'even more' after 比.

examples.text: 还没有吗？请记下我们客栈的电话和地址，谢谢！
examples.trans: Not yet? Please write down our inn's phone number and address, thank you!

examples.text: 宋老师，真对不起，那边还没有消息。
examples.trans: Teacher Song, I am truly sorry; they have no news over there yet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: dōu. Summarizes everything BEFORE it and always stands directly before the verb/adjective (我们都喜欢).

examples.text: 谢谢！我们平时都直接叫名字吗？
examples.trans: Thank you! Do we usually just call each other by name here?

examples.text: 小美跟这条街上所有人说话都像老朋友。
examples.trans: Mei talks to everyone on this street like old friends.

meanings.note: Pinyin: lǐ. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 里面 ('the inside').

examples.text: 在抽屉里。我们这儿用这个大纸本子和铅笔。
examples.trans: In the drawer. Here we use this big paper ledger and a pencil.

examples.text: 在您的外套口袋里吗？
examples.trans: Are they in your coat pocket?

meanings.note: Pinyin: yào shi. Measure word (量词): 把 (bǎ), e.g. 一把钥匙 ('a key').

examples.text: 有道理！这些是钥匙吗？
examples.trans: Fair enough! Are these the keys?

examples.text: 对，八间客房，八把铜钥匙。四号房的客人今天到。
examples.trans: Yes, eight rooms, eight brass keys. Room four's guest arrives today.

meanings.note: Pinyin: tié guǐ. Measure word: 条 (tiáo) or 根 (gēn), e.g. 两条铁轨 ('two steel rails').

examples.text: 铁轨维修把他的晚班车改到了下午直达成都的快车上！
examples.trans: Track repairs shifted his evening connection onto the fast afternoon express straight into Chengdu!

examples.text: 兄弟俩走到三号站台时，铁轨远处已经传来了快车的鸣笛声。
examples.trans: As the brothers reached platform three, the express train's whistle sounded down the tracks.

meanings.note: Pinyin: wèn. Everyday verb for asking a question (请问 'may I ask').

examples.text: 等等——先生您好！您问那个深蓝色行李箱吗？
examples.trans: Wait—hello, sir! Are you asking about that dark-blue suitcase?

examples.text: 快问他叫什么名字！记下来！
examples.trans: Quick, ask him what his name is! Write it down!

meanings.note: Pinyin: yuàn zi. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个院子 ('a courtyard').

examples.text: 太好了。窗户朝街上还是朝院子？
examples.trans: Wonderful. Does the window face the street or the courtyard?

examples.text: 朝院子，就在老树上面，非常安静。
examples.trans: Toward the courtyard, right above the old tree; it is very quiet.

meanings.note: Pinyin: pinyin. This is a noun used in conversational Mandarin. Measure word (量词): 个 (gè), e.g. 一个面糊 ('a 面糊').

examples.text: 我有一个面糊。
examples.trans: I have a 面糊.

examples.text: 这是一个非常好的面糊。
examples.trans: This is a very good 面糊.

meanings.note: Pinyin: bí liáng. Measure word: 根 (gēn) or 条 (tiáo); classic spot where glasses rest.

examples.text: 你跨出门槛之前，好歹先把老花镜架到鼻梁上呀！
examples.trans: At least put your reading glasses onto the bridge of your nose before you cross the threshold!

examples.text: 周经理笑着推了推鼻梁上的眼镜，细细念起成都老院文化节的来信。
examples.trans: Smiling, Manager Zhou nudged the glasses up the bridge of his nose and read the Historic Courtyard Festival letter aloud.
